violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked beef (117F), cooked chicken (111F) in front soup wells.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge reheated beef and chicken to 165F.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers stored on shelf above prep sink in active use in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Person in charge discarded drink container.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw beef stored above cooked corn in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. person in charge placed all raw animal foods below all food that is ready to eat.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: containers and lids from dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine bleach.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Person in charge replaced chlorine cartridge and properly sanitized all equipment.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: falafel (102F) in steam well at front expo; grilled chicken (114F), cooked steak (118-132F) in front warmer wells.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge reheated all listed items to 165F. SWEET LEAF CAFE (Inspection Date: 03/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed raw salmon fillets actively thawing in intact reduced oxygen packaging in 3 door upright cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Person in charge removed fish fillets from packaging.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 Door prep refrigerator w/ cold rail at 50F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC time marked food items not to exceed 4 hours and also moved TCS food items to working refrigeration units. PIC contacted service technician to repair unit.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. SWEET LEAF CAFE (Inspection Date: 03/31/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: goat cheese and tzatziki sauce observed at 48F and 43F respectively in the countertop cold holding unit near the register.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS recommended discarding the foods. PIC stated the food had been in holding for 1 hour and switched the warmer items with cold ones. EHS recommended placing lids on the containers, and ice underneath the items in the cold well until repairs can be made to the machine.
